title: Home & Farmstead: Waste, Rats, Plumbing (USDA)

description: Keeping rats out of homes, barns and food stores; septic tanks, privies and chemical toilets; disposing of garbage and trash by burning, burial and composting when collection stops; and fixing faucets, leaks, frozen pipes, toilets and clogged drains. Superseded bulletins from 1930–1972: methods are practical, but materials, codes and some advice (such as open burning) are dated — check local rules and current guidance.
